title: Interstellar
plot: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.
review: I cried and sobbed watching this beautiful film with the most amazing theme too!!

title: Wonder
plot: Based on the New York Times bestseller, this movie tells the incredibly inspiring and heartwarming story of August Pullman, a boy with facial differences who enters the fifth grade, attending a mainstream elementary school for the...
review: One of the kindest movies in the late 2010s, the book is already amazing and the film stays close to it, not losing the spark, emotions and love that come with it. The cast was also so so great!

title: Notting Hill
plot: A set of circumstances makes Anna Scott, a famous actress, fall in love with William Thacker, owner of a bookstore in Notting Hill. But the paparazzi's fascination with her complicates their bond.
review: such a classic in the romcom game, and my first one on top. Will def always stay close to me

title: Pretty Woman
plot: A corporate raider hires a hooker to act as a business escort in Beverly Hills, California.

title: The Princess Diaries
plot: Mia Thermopolis has just found out that she is the heir apparent to the throne of Genovia. With her friends Lilly and Michael Moscovitz in tow, she tries to navigate through the rest of her sixteenth year.
review: one of my most important comfort movies.. and the worlds introduction to Annie Hathaway!!

title: The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
plot: Now settled in Genovia, Princess Mia faces a new revelation: she is being primed for an arranged marriage to an English suitor.
review: not as fantastic as the first one but certainly worth watching

title: Shaun the Sheep
plot: Shaun The Sheep is a cheeky and mischievous sheep at Mossy Bottom farm who's the leader of the flock and always plays slapstick jokes, pranks and causes trouble especially on Farmer X and his grumpy guide dog, Bitzer.
review: you know those moments when you dont know what to watch and the whole family throws in suggestions? maybe just turn back to shaun the sheep and give that one a try.... usually ends uo with everyone laughing in nostalgia

title: Staatsschutz
plot: After a racist assault, prosecutor Seyo Kim pursues her own case through the courts, challenging both her attackers and a legal system that ignores right-wing extremism.
review: sehr berührend und irgendwie besonders, gerade wenn man nicht aus dem Osten kommt

title: Silent Friend
plot: Tales told from the perspective of a lonely old tree standing in the middle of a botanical garden.

title: Etwas ganz Besonderes
plot: Asked who she is by a TV talent show crew, Lea starts questioning her identity while living at her family's hotel in former East Germany's forests.

title: Filipiñana
plot: The self-contained cosmos of the golf and country club reflects Philippine societal structures. New 'tee-girl' Isabel still needs to learn the rules, but she's already looking for ways to subvert the system.

title: Wunderschön
plot: Five women of different ages are confronted with their self-image and the demands of themselves and others.

title: The Drama
plot: A happily-engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

title: The Devil Wears Prada
plot: Andy, a smart but sensible young journalist, starts working as an assistant to the cynical high fashion magazine editor Miranda Priestly.

title: Finding Nemo
plot: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.
